verifiedProductionDefinition: An item counts as verified production only when it is schema-valid, deduplicated per COUNTING_POLICY.md, license-verified for redistribution, and provenance-complete. Anything else is validated-only, seed, estimate, or excluded - never production.

categories.notes: One item per (source, upstream id, ecosystem, package): 100 files collapse to 84 items (shards share the key; see scripts/dedup-report.mjs). Validated-only: license review complete (docs/LICENSE_REVIEW.md) but owner authorization pending; breadth frozen under the data lock.

Lexical line rules with executable positive/negative examples. 1000x pump 2026-10-19 added 19 original rules across two batches (log CRLF forging, debug mode, assert authorization, uuid1 tokens, plaintext clone, container pinning/root/remote ADD, workflow_run, secrets inherit, PHP unserialize, JVM expression evaluation, Spring permitAll, Express stack disclosure, Function constructor, JS/Python ReDoS, JWT verify off, Ruby Marshal.load); D-13 legacy records stay inactive.
Original shape-only credential rules; one item per DPK-SEC id. Shape match only, never a liveness claim.

Original passive observation checks; one item per DPK-DAST id. Closed check vocabulary; active probing not expressible. 1000x additive pump 2026-10-19 added 3 observation checks (SameSite=None without Secure, non-nosniff X-Content-Type-Options, report-only CSP); synthetic observations only.
Own-words summaries with canonical MITRE links; one item per CWE id. Canonical definitions are never copied.
Original guidance content; one item per pack ruleId (951/951 enforced). Content fields only; status stays app-computed.
